notes: Each case runs twice: with the skill and without it (same model, same prompt). The skill earns its place only if it wins clearly on the expectations. Cases that need approval are judged on turn 1 (what the skill delivers before the candidate answers) unless 'turn 2' is stated. All people and companies in files/ are fictional; binary fixtures are rebuilt with make_fixtures.py.
